summary: Iteration 2 checked the targeted fixes and ran a regression pass. All fixes work: rotated admin password (UI login goes to /admin, old password returns 401, tried once), test file no longer hardcodes credentials, JSON-LD escaping, stable React keys. Backend pytest: 102 passed, 1 skipped. Regression flows on the public URL all pass: desktop clothing-rack hover and click to the product page, mobile 390px numbered selectors and next button, register, add to bag, wishlist, COD checkout to the order page with its timeline, customer login to /account.

issues: Heading says 'Your order is awaiting payment' while the timeline says 'Confirmed'. This is expected because COD is paid on delivery, but the copy feels inconsistent. Consider a COD-specific heading such as 'Order confirmed — pay on delivery'. This is frontend copy only.
Old-style serif numerals in the 01-10 selector chips (e.g. 02, 07) are hard to read at 390px. Consider lining numerals (font-variant-numeric: lining-nums).

action_items: Optional: lining numerals in rack selectors
critical_code_review_comments: Common.jsx: JSON-LD uses .replace(/</g,'\u003c'). Output checked: valid JSON with no raw '<' on /shop and /product/pastel-stripe-dress
Home editorials use key e.link||e.title; OrderView timeline uses status-at; Breadcrumbs use label-to. No React key warnings in console
Remaining index keys in Common.jsx:33-40 (rich text paragraphs) and the Home.jsx:77 marquee are fine because those lists are static
401 console errors for anonymous users come from the session check and are expected
